data.businessDescription: Vistry Group Plc engages in housing development activities. The firm's business is involved in the design, build, and sale of new homes for both private customers and social landlords. It offers a portfolio of properties ranging from one and two bedroom apartments to five and six bedroom detached family homes. The company was founded as a separate company in 1965 and is headquartered in West Malling, the United Kingdom.
Wendel SE engages in the acquisition and management of investment portfolios. The company was founded in 1704 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

Gerresheimer AG engages in the manufacturing and supplies glass and plastic products for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry. It operates through the following segments: Plastic and Devices, Primary Packaging Glass, and Advanced Technologies. The Plastic and Devices segment includes insulin pens, inhalers and refillable syringes as well as diagnostics and medical technology products such as skin-prick aids and test systems and pharmaceutical plastic containers for liquid and solid medicines. The Primary Packaging Glass segment refers to the primary packaging made of glass of medicines and cosmetics such as pharma jars, ampoules, injection vials, cartridges, perfume flacons and cream jars, and special containers for food and drinks. The Advanced Technologies segment focuses on the technical and digital solutions to improve patient treatment outcomes. The company was founded in 1864 and is headquartered in Duesseldorf, Germany.

Caltagirone SpA is a holding company, which engages in the cement, publishing and advertising, and construction through its subisidiaries. It also deals with the real estate, financing, and infrastructures sectors. The company was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Rome, Italy.

data.businessDescription: Renault SA engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles. It operates through the following business segments: Automotive, Sales Financing and Mobility Services. The Automotive segment deals with the production of passenger cars, and light commercial vehicles and provides automotive services. The Sales Financing segment refers to the activity carried out for the distribution network and final customers by RCI Banque, its subsidiaries and investments in associates and joint ventures. The Mobility Services segment provides services for new mobilities. Its brands include Renault, Dacia, LADA, Alpine, and Mobilize. The company was founded by Louis Renault in 1898 and is headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.

Lenzing AG engages in the production and marketing of botanic cellulose fibers. It operates through the following segments: Division Fiber, Division Pulp, and Others. The Division Fiber produces all three generations of wood-based cellulosic fibers and markets them under the product brands TENCEL, VEOCEL, LENZING ECOVERO, and LENZING. The Division Pulp is involved in the production and procurement of dissolving pulp for fiber production. The Others segment covers the business activities of BZL-Bildungszentrum Lenzing GmbH, which provides training and personnel development. The company was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Lenzing, Austria.

Dometic Group AB engages in the provision of branded solutions for mobile living in the areas of climate; power and control; hygiene and sanitation; and food and beverage. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas; Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA); Asia Pacific (APAC); Marine; and Global. The Marine segment includes the entire Dometic marine operation. The Global segment focuses on the other global verticals such as residential, hospitality, and mobile deliveries; and Igloo business, a supplier of passive cooling boxes and drinkware products. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.

MOL Hungarian Oil and Gas Plc engages in the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas. It operates through the following segments: Upstream, Downstream, Consumer Services, Gas Midstream, and Corporate and Other. The Upstream segment covers production fields and assets under construction. The Downstream segment represents filling stations and oil refineries. The Consumer segment consists of machineries and equipment in filling stations. The Gas Midstream segment provides distribution and trade of natural gas. The Corporate and Other segment focuses on oilfield service equipment. The company was founded on October 1, 1991 and is headquartered in Budapest, Hungary.

data.businessDescription: Douglas AG engages in the distribution, retail, and wholesale of beauty products through its physical and online stores. It operates through the following segments: DACHNL, France, Southern Europe, Central-Eastern-Europe, and Parfumdreams/Niche Beauty. The DACHNL segment consists of the operations in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Netherlands, and Belgium. The France segment refers to the operations in France and Monaco. The Southern Europe segment is composed of the operations in Italy, Spain, Andorra, Portugal, Croatia, and Slovenia. The Central-Eastern-Europe segment pertains to the operations in Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria, Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia. The company was founded by John Sharp Douglas in 1821 and is headquartered in Duesseldorf, Germany.

data.businessDescription: Harbour Energy Plc is an oil and gas company, which engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of oil and gas reserves and related activities. It operates through North Sea and International segments. The North Sea segment includes the UK and Norwegian Continental Shelves. The International segment focuses in the Indonesia, Vietnam and Mexico. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

data.businessDescription: Dar Global Plc engages in the development of real estate projects focusing on second homes, typically in locations in the Middle East and Europe. It also develops and markets properties in partnership with brands such as Automobili Lamborghini, W Residences, Missoni, and Pagani. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Real Estate Investment and Services

data.businessDescription: Scandic Hotels Group AB engages in the operation of hotels. It owns and operates hotels in the mid-market segment under the brand name Scandic. It operates through the following geographical segments: Sweden, Norway, Finland, and Other Europe. The Other Europe segment includes operations in Denmark, Poland and Germany. The company was founded on March 27, 2006 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Etex NV engages in the provision of building materials. Its solutions include interiors, exteriors, industrial solutions, insulation, offsite construction, and passive fire protection. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, Latin America, Australia, Asia, Africa, and Rest of World. The company was founded by Alphonse Emsens in 1905 and is headquartered in Zaventem, Belgium.

Louis Hachette Group SA is a developing stage company that does not currently have any business operations. It intends to operate publishing and travel retail businesses through its subsidiaries. The company was founded in 1826 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

Telekom Austria AG is a holding company, which engages in the provision of telecommunications and multimedia services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Belarus, Slovenia, Serbia, North Macedonia, and Corporate and Other. Its products include voice, mobile, satellite, data, and roaming. The company was founded in July 1998 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.

Grand City Properties SA engages in the business of developing residential real estate and investing in value-add opportunities in densely populated areas. The company was founded on December 16, 2011 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.

Infortar AS provides real estate investment services. It invests in hotels and spas in Tallinn and Riga. The firm also serves in the area of shipping and transportation, hospitality, real estate, printing, trading, financial service industries and energetics. The company was founded on April 9, 1997 and is headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia.

data.businessDescription: Bonheur ASA is a holding company, which engages in long term investment within the shipping and energy related activities, transportation, technology and property development, leisure, and other enterprises. It operates through the following segments: Renewable Energy, Wind Service, Cruise, and Other Investments. The Renewable Energy segment develops, constructs, and operates wind farms in Scotland, Norway, Sweden, Ireland, France, and the U.S. The Wind Service segment offers logistics and services within the offshore wind industry. The Cruise segment owns and operates cruise ships; and provides a diverse range of cruises to attract its passenger. The Other Investments segment represents investments within media, properties, and various service companies. Bonheur ASA was founded on October 20, 1897 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

Banijay Group NV is a holding company, which engages in the provision of content production and online sports betting platforms. It operates through the following segments: Banijay Entertainment and Live, Banijay Gaming, and Holding. The Banijay Entertainment and Live segment incorporates the activities of production, distribution and marketing of content property rights for television and multimedia platforms as well as the production of live experiences. The Banijay Gaming segment comprises sports betting, poker, casino and turf. The Holding segment is involved in corporate activities. The company was founded by Stéphane Courbit in 1994 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

Austevoll Seafood ASA is an pelagic fishery and seafood company, which engages in producing of fish meal and fish oil. It operates through the following segments: LSG, Austral Group, FoodCorp Chile, Br. Birkeland, Kobbevik og Furuholmen Oppdrett, and Pelagia Holding. The LSG segment is involved in fish farming, fishery of white fish and VAP of salmon, trout and white fish, and sale and distribution of fish species and processed fish products. The Austral Group segment includes production of fishmeal, fish oil, canned fish, and frozen fish. The Foodcorp Chile segment holds a fleet of purse-seiner vessels. The Br. Birkeland segment holds pelagic fishing licenses which are utilized by purse-seiner fishing vessels, in addition the company owns vessels with license to fish snow crab. The Kobbevik og Furuholmen Oppdret segment holds salmon farming licenses. The Pelagia Holding segment engages in the production of fishmeal, fish oil, Omega-3 oil, frozen fish for direct human consumption; and protein concentrate and oil based on cuttings from the salmon insustry, whitefish industry, and pelagic cuttings. The company was founded by Helge Arvid Mogster, Ole Rasmus Mogster, and Alf Mogster on April 14, 1981 and is headquartered in Storebo, Norway.
